wstep: There is no recipe here for homemade peanut, walnut, hazelnut or almond butter.

ostrzezenia.tekst: In the NCHFP section on canning nuts and nut products, the only process is for green peanuts; NCHFP gives no canning process for peanut butter or other nut butters.
NCHFP says more recent research has shown that some species of Salmonella tolerate drier (low water activity) conditions.

akapity: NCHFP no longer recommends canning a dry pack of shelled nutmeats at home, and there is currently no substitute canning process for dry packs of nutmeats.
EFSA says aflatoxins can occur in foods such as groundnuts and tree nuts as a result of fungal contamination before and after harvest, and they are genotoxic and carcinogenic.
